# Local-minimum position within the cell (generated by bumpphase.py)

Local minima of T(x, goal) along the true paths of queries >= 8 cells; phase = position along the direction of travel modulo one cell (0 = grid line, 0.5 = cell centre). R = concentration of the phases (0 = even; chance level about 1/sqrt(count)). Path reference: all path samples. Ripple: the field error along the true paths minus its two-cell moving average, relative to the query travel time; locked share = fraction of the ripple variance explained by the position within the cell.
